newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate edges higher.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate edges higher.

text.p: Zambia's central bank said on Monday that it sold three-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 25.6169 percent at its latest auction.
The bank said it sold 12 billion of the 91-day treasury bills on tenders received at last Thursday's weekly auction. The discount rate was up slightly from the previous week's 25.1484 percent.
It said eight billion of the 28-day treasury bills were sold at an average discount rate of 20.1552 percent, down from 20.2589 percent.
The bank sold three billion six-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 23.5303 percent, up from the previous week's 23.1967 percent
